high.title: Unsanitized user input in dynamic HTML insertion (XSS)
high.description: ## Description Unsanitized user input in dynamic HTML insertion can lead to Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) attacks. This vulnerability arises when user-provided data is directly inserted into the DOM without proper sanitization, potentially allowing attackers to execute malicious scripts. ## Remediations - **Do** use an HTML sanitization library to clean user input before inserting it into the HTML. This step helps prevent XSS attacks by removing or neutralizing any potentially harmful scripts. ```javascript import sanitizeHtml from 'sanitize-html'; const html = `${user.Input}`; document.body.innerHTML = sanitizeHtml(html); ``` ## References - [OWASP XSS explained](https://owasp.org/www-community/attacks/xss/)
